messages.1000002: Wow, it's rare to have guests here.
messages.1000003:
May I ask who you are?
And how can I be of service to you?
messages.1000004: Cardinal Barshival wants to give the sacred relics to me now?
messages.1000008: Anyways, you are welcome in my shrine anytime.
messages.1000009:
I'm Sena, or Altecia in a way.
Some say I'm the White Angel herself, but
we share the same spirit more than the same looks.
messages.1000010:
You could say she has possessed my body.
The sacred relics and the coming of the Devil Dignosis
have roused the spirit of Altecia within me.
messages.1000012:
I understand.
You want to go Hiperion to find the truth.
messages.1000013:
That's a good idea,
but you'll need the five orbs to withstand the power of Dignosis
since you're a mortal human.
messages.1000014:
It seems that
you already have two of the orbs.
messages.1000015:
First of all, you must go to an institute,
a ruin near a village called Berini,
to get the blue and green orbs.
messages.1000016:
After that,
please come back here.
messages.1000017: Oh, hello. We've been seeing a lot of each other lately.
messages.1000018: Oh, hello. We've been seeing a lot of each other lately.
messages.1000022: You've got the blue and green orbs, do you?
messages.1000023:
You might be able to withstand
the power of Dignosis now.
messages.1000024:
The last orb,
the Red Orb, is kept in a tower in Berini Village.
messages.1000025: Come back again once you've obtained it.
messages.1000026: Hi, your journey must've been long and hard. Would you like some coffee?
messages.1000030: It looks that you've got all the orbs.
messages.1000031: I can feel the magic flowing within you.
messages.1000033:
Let me tell you about everything,
even the truth that the Noil religious sect is unaware of.
messages.1000035:
Long ago, human beings were at the height of their prosperity.
Science, or what you call the Ancient World's technology,
enabled them to do extraordinary things,
and everybody lived well.
messages.1000036:
They had incredible power and were even able to control the weather.
Manipulating the weather changed deserts to fields of grass and frozen
wastelands to inhabitable areas.
messages.1000037:
In the world back then, Dignosis and I
were scientists.
messages.1000038: Our world went on peacefully until something happened...
messages.1000039:
Dignosis was an excellent scientist, and together
we did research on the untapped possibilities of human beings.
messages.1000040:
In short, we did research to strengthen human beings
and allow them to live longer.
messages.1000041: Our research led to a fascinating discovery.
messages.1000042:
On the other hand,
our discovery was the beginning of the end...
messages.1000043:
At first, people applauded the results we
achieved and called it a great discovery.
But soon after, they changed their minds.
They denounced our research as acts of evil.
messages.1000044:
Dignosis' research into strengthening human beings
was particulary villainized. Eventually, he was labeled
an enemy of humankind.
messages.1000045:
He was deeply hurt by the accusations and
truly believed his research was for the good of humankind.
messages.1000046:
He continued his work and hoped one day everyone would
understand and embrace what he had accomplished.
messages.1000048:
The military was given orders
to capture him. Instead of targeting just Dignosis,
his family was judged complicit and they were...
messages.1000051:
Dignosis was forced to help the military,
and he began work on evil experiments.
messages.1000052:
The results frightened the military and they feared his not being able to
contain his power. They were about to imprison him and discontinue his research.
Dignosis, however, anticipated these attempts and had a plan in place.
messages.1000053:
He transformed himself into a powerful demon-like creature
and created an army of similiar creatures to fight alongside him. He also
used biological agents to morph humans into these demons on contact. He created and
used what can only be described as evil magical powers.
messages.1000054:
He was consumed by a hatred
towards humankind...
Nobody could stop him.
The rate of infection was astronomical.
messages.1000055:
The few that survived were those that could protect themselves
against the biological agents, like scientists and people in the
military. It was, however, only a matter of time
before almost everyone was infected or killed.
messages.1000056:
I was his partner and worked along side him on his research.
Naturally, I felt I had the ability and the knowledge to
stop him.
messages.1000057:
I followed his lead by changing myself into one of his
demons and tracked him down. I succeeded in sealing him away.
The effort this required crippled me physically.
messages.1000058:
Those are the events that led to this cursed world.
I suppose that Dignosis has risen from Hiperion
where I sealed him away.
messages.1000059:
The five orbs have the power to fight against his magic.
If you use my sacred crest, you can exercise this power.
messages.1000060:
Also, the Spiritual coat of arms
has the ability to replenish your power.
messages.1000061: The reason I tell you this is I sense unusual powers in you.
messages.1000062:
Hopefully, I have helped you live up to your potential.
The fate of this world is in your hands.
messages.1000063:
Go to Hiperion
and do what you believe is best for this world.
messages.1000066:
As you know, Dignosis nearly destroyed the world and committed acts
for which he'll never be forgiven,
messages.1000067:
but I would like you to at least remember that he could've easily been
a savior of mankind had things gone differently.
messages.1000070:
The world is appreciative of what you've done.
I will continue in this body, carrying Altecia's spirit
with me until I pass away.
messages.1000071: If you ever have the chance, please visit me.
messages.1000073:
This may be too much to ask of you,
but I know that
you're the only person who can help me.
messages.1000074:
After Dignosis was sealed away, powerful demons under
his control gathered at the Fort of Demons.
messages.1000075:
They are also powerful,
although less so than Dignosis.
They may havoc if they are not dealt with.
messages.1000076:
Enemy Hole, a transportation system in Ento Village,
leads to the Fort of Demons, but the transport is only for demons.
Without the Demon Fang, human beings cannot use the system.
messages.1000077:
Demons of the Forest of Poison used to have the Demon Fang,
but I'm not sure where it is kept now.
messages.1000078: Can I ask you to defeat the demons at the Fort of Demons?
messages.1000079: You're alive. I suppose you pulled it off?
messages.1000080:
Thank you so much.
Please accept this Companion Stone as a reward.
This reduces the time required for your companions
to recover.
messages.1000081:
Oh, the demons in the Fort of Demons were human before becoming
infected. The infection destroyed their ability to reason.
messages.1000082:
By the way, the demons in the Fort of Demons and The Ruins of
Remoteness seem to like Collector's Items
and horde them as well as they can.
messages.1000083:
It might also be useful to know that rumor has it the Demon Fang
has the ability to recover spiritual powers.
